justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr, Value, BinOp, UnaryOp, and EvalError variants, but TypeError carries a stringly-typed message rather than structured fields identifying operator and operand types.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums distinguish the required cases and the library never panics on valid use, but TypeError uses a String payload and the unreachable! branches in arithmetic/comparison match arms are undocumented.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public items are documented with doc comments, Display/Debug are implemented as required, and derives are sensible, but ParseError fields are pub (leaking representation) and neither error type implements std::error::Error.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, matches!, iterator-style env lookup, and derive macros consistently, though the env is a Vec<(String, Value)> with linear scan and several String clones could be avoided with borrowed lookups.
